semantic_spine.literal_event: A man speaks dismissively across a worktable while flicking aside a woman's physical model, and she quietly absorbs the verbal disparagement.
semantic_spine.semantic_focus: The dismissive posture and belittling gesture directed at the physical project and its creator.
semantic_spine.emotional_relation: condescending aggression met with restrained inner tension
semantic_spine.memory_hook: A dismissive hand flick pushing aside an intricate handmade geometric model across a shared wooden desk.

special_device.reason: The three planned shots cleanly split the social cause, physical detail, and somatic consequence without requiring a panel breakout or gutter crossing.

page_design.eye_flow_summary: Top-left establishes the speaker leaning across the desk toward the right; top-right looks down at his hand shoving the model pieces aside; the broad lower panel resolves on the woman's face and rigid posture absorbing the insult.

panels.semantic_job: Establish the dismissive speech and physical proximity between the speaker and the creator.

scene.description: In an airy design workshop, a man leans with one hand on a timber worktable, gesturing flippantly with his other hand as he talks toward a woman seated opposite him.

subjects.figure: Tall man in a dark rollneck sweater
subjects.pose: Leaning forward over the desk, one hand resting on the wood, the other raised in a dismissive outward flick

subjects.figure: Woman in an earth-tone collared shirt
subjects.pose: Sitting upright across the table, hands resting still beside a finished physical model

camera.focus: The speaking man's condescending expression and flicked wrist
camera.eye_flow_exit: The man's right hand pointing toward the tabletop components

scene.lighting: Clean, directional studio daylight from window high-left casting soft shadows on the table

panels.semantic_job: Focus on the physical object of belittlement being casually pushed aside.

scene.description: Looking down from the man's vantage, his index finger casually slides a delicate balsa-wood lattice structure aside, tilting it off its base.

subjects.figure: Dark sweater cuff and masculine hand
subjects.pose: A single curled index finger shoving a miniature balsa-wood structure across the green mat
subjects.expression: Not visible; focus on hand contact

midground: Textured green cutting mat with gridlines
background: Polished oak table grain receding into soft blur

camera.focus: The contact between his fingernail and the fragile wooden joint of the model
camera.eye_flow_exit: The tilted edge of the displaced model falling toward bottom-right

scene.lighting: Crisp overhead daylight highlighting the brittle edges of the balsa model and the shadow under his finger

panels.semantic_job: Deliver the full emotional weight through the woman's tightly restrained reaction.

scene.description: A wide, centered medium-close framing of the woman; she holds her chin level with lowered eyes, lips pressed into a hard line, her fingers locked rigidly on the edge of the desk.

subjects.figure: Woman with hair pinned back, wearing a collared linen shirt
subjects.pose: Shoulders drawn tight and square, both hands clutching the wooden edge of the worktable until knuckles pale
subjects.expression: Clenched jaw muscle, downcast gaze, tightly closed mouth holding back a reply
subjects.blocking: Centered in the lower panoramic frame

foreground: The sturdy forward lip of the workshop table where her knuckles rest
midground: Her rigid upper torso and tense neckline
background: Out-of-focus shelves stacked with plaster molds and wood stock under soft studio lighting

camera.focus: Her clenched jaw and tightly gripped knuckles
camera.eye_flow_exit: The tension in her hands anchoring the bottom edge of the entire layout

scene.lighting: Subtle side-lighting catching the strain in her jawline and the taut contour of her shoulders
